# Long Document Fixture

This fixture exists to measure markdown-doc-viewer panel-ready latency
under a realistic large document. Generated deterministically for T2's
performance acceptance check (docs/plans/2026-09-04-zs-implementation-plan.md).

| Body | 3 per section | 20000 |
